modelMapping.borrowerSegmentation: The official FPC LTI flow limit is aggregate across new residential mortgages. The model stores separate first-time buyer and home mover soft caps and max-fraction parameters, so v4.16 sets both borrower groups to the same threshold and fraction.
modelMapping.sharedQuota: Because the FTB and HM max-fraction parameters are equal, the Java bank logic uses the shared owner-occupier quota path.
modelMapping.deMinimisThreshold: The November 2024 FPC Record recommends increasing the lender-size de minimis threshold to GBP 150 million, but this model has no lender-size threshold parameter. The value is retained for audit only.

methodDecision: Objective=direct method justification; Why=the Bank of England November 2024 FPC Record is the official 2024 central-bank policy source and directly states the 4.5 LTI threshold and 15% flow limit; Tradeoff=the model approximates the aggregate FPC recommendation with equal FTB/HM parameters and cannot encode the lender-size de minimis threshold.
